notes.title: Steam VR Fest Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/fd88f3cb667a2d50ed3d4cc19fae3287f0cd6221.png[/img]

Pipeline VR is at a huge discount of 40% during Steam's VR Fest. That's under a fiver!

Are you quick enough to complete the pipeline before the room fills up with water?
Do you have what it takes to stay calm under pressure?

Then put those claims to the test through multiple levels of Pipeline mayhem!

Pick it up today and show us what you've got.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/dc08b14b93257d787b71a2bbb3dbceb8630395cd.gif[/img]


Picked it up already? , let us know of your experience!

Got to an impressive height in Tower mode?
Found all the ducks?
Discovered an interesting easter egg?
We would love to hear your achievements in the discussions!

Also let us know if there is anything you would like to see in the game. 

And most of all, feel free to leave Pipeline a review! It [b]really[/b] helps us out so we can ensure we can make the game the best it can be!

notes.title: V1.08
notes.content: This small update fixes a bug in the sewer that could cause players using locomotion to freeze in place when bumping into a specific area.

notes.title: Version 1.07 Released
notes.content:
This update removes any issues with pipes not snapping when they seemingly should, as well as make it easier to detect when snapping will occur.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed pipes sometimes dropping when they should have snapped.
[*]Enlarged the snapping trigger.
[*]Added Haptics when in range of a snap. (Should also help blind placement!)
[/list]

If you experience any bugs and issues, [b]please let us know[/b] in the "Bugs and Technical Issues" section of the discussion board.
We are only a small team but we want to help solve problems as fast as possible! So any feedback is incredibly helpful.

Also feel free to contact us to give feedback or drop a review.

Happy Plumbing!

The Everwake Team

notes.title: Smooth Locomotion Update!
notes.content:
With the new locomotion settings, you can now move around and smooth/snap turn via joysticks. 
Useful for those with a less than minimum playspace.

[b]Where can I find this setting?[/b]
Locomotion can be found via the new "Locomotion Settings" button within the newspaper settings page. Here you can choose to turn smooth locomotion on and off, pick smooth or snap turning, as well as the angle of your snap turn.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/cbce4c1b8a3c3d32d1be02bcb9fb18150be1c3cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/ce0b102bc0b7dfa7abd4e8d0f53cb8ac61c82b09.png[/img]


[b]Why was this added now?[/b]
Pipeline VR is at its heart and design a roomscale game, so we were initially hesitant in adding this feature as we felt it could reduce the hectic fun a roomscale game brings. However, we know that sometimes options are good and wanted to be sure that players can play their way. After hearing feedback, we knew it was time to give the option.

[b]What is the new minimum playspace?[/b]
While we can't give an exact measurement, you will still need enough space to physically crouch and move your arms.

[b]I have another feature request![/b]
Great!, let us know what it is. We love to hear your ideas.

This method of movement is currently experimental, so we would love to hear opinions and feedback. So please get in touch and let us know what you think!

Happy Plumbing!
The Everwake Team

notes.title: Pipeline VR Out Now On Steam
notes.content:
Everwake Games is proud to announce that Pipeline VR has been released!


Pipeline VR is a hectic virtual reality puzzle game, that pits you against a rising tide of torrential water.
Connect the pipes to stem the flow before the room fills up with you inside.

With a focus on panic, human error and speed, will you be able to keep your cool as the water inches higher?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/dc08b14b93257d787b71a2bbb3dbceb8630395cd.gif[/img]


Pipeline VR contains:
[list]
[*] Satisfying pipe snapping
[*] *Faux physical water
[*] Advanced VR physics interactions
[*] Infinite replay-ability
[*] Five unique settings each with their own environmental challenges
[*] Four modes
[*] Unique art style
[/list]

What good is rising water without the urgency? Well, we at Everwake Games have worked tirelessly to ensure that the water "feels" as real as we could. 
By tying shaders, filters, collisions, haptics, sounds and underwater physics together to create what we call "*faux physical water", you can feel immersed while you are being immersed.
So much in fact, you may find yourself holding your breath.


So grab your tools and your Handy-o-Matic Pipe dispenser and plunge in to help the residents of Pipesville with their plumbing disasters!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/defc6288eaa43c0ef0503e58d4a4f4c27938d2e5.gif[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/03e71bda780e7d0af5426f9767ee4569d6078ac8.png[/img]

Everwake Games is happy to announce that players can now test their plumbing prowess in our PipeLine VR Demo!

We are coming to the end of the pipeline as the release draws ever so closer. With Steam Next Fest celebrating all things demo, we decided to let players experience what is to come.


So grab your tools and get a sneak peek of the game and let us know what you think!
